title: Indian-Style Curry Wrap
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired wrap filled with tender chicken and a blend of spices.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together curry paste, brown sugar, and water.
2. Add the chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
4. Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
6. Assemble the wrap by spreading the curry sauce on the wrap, followed by sliced chicken, and finishing with any desired toppings.
